name: ExpirePress
author: WP Square

sections.description:
ExpirePress is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to automate post management by allowing users to set expiry actions for their content. This versatile tool empowers site administrators to specify a date and time for posts to automatically perform actions such as transitioning to draft status, moving to trash, permanent deletion, privacy settings adjustments, category changes, title updates, or exclusion from sitemaps and search results.

Key Features:

  • Expiration Actions: Automatically transition posts to draft, trash, delete permanently, set to private, password protect, change categories, update titles, hide from sitemap, and exclude from search results.
  • User-Friendly Interface: Easily configure expiration dates and actions directly from the WordPress admin panel.
  • Versatility: Compatible with various post types, including custom post types.
  • Compatibility: Fully compatible with WordPress 5.2 and above, ensuring it works seamlessly with the latest WordPress releases.
  • Localization: Includes language files for translation support.

Troubleshooting

  1. Ensure the ExpirePress plugin is activated and your WordPress version is at least 5.2.
  2. Deactivate other plugins to check for conflicts.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the expirepress folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure your expiration settings in the Post Editor Page.
sections.faq:
Can I set different expiration actions for different post types?

Yes, ExpirePress supports custom post types and allows you to set specific actions for each post type.

Is there documentation available?

Yes, you can find detailed documentation on our website at ExpirePress Documentation.
